text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
見るがよい、あれこそが冥界の門じゃ。ただ、
実体化にはいましばらく時間がかかりそうじゃな。
text.official_en:
Behold—an underworld gate. Though it may be some
time before it manifests.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まず対処すべきは、
実体化を控えた門じゃ。たとえば……
text.official_en:
'Tis important to keep an eye on gates ready to
manifest into our world.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
実体化を目前に控えた門というものは、
このように禍々しい気配を纏っておる。
text.official_en:
You can tell a gate's time is drawing near by the
dread aura coiling around it, like so.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
その時がきた際にすぐ向かえるよう、
常に備えておくがよい。
text.official_en:
When we see the sign, we must be ready to head
out to it at a moment's notice.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
さらなる部隊を編成することで、なんと
複数部隊を同時に運用することもできるのじゃ。
text.official_en:
By forming more squads, you can put several of them
to work at once.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダグシオンで待機する者も遊んでおる訳ではない。
戦いに備え、日々経験を積んでおるのじゃ。
text.official_en:
Whatever units are left in reserve in Dagsion aren't
idle, mind you. They gain experience each day.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この施設は破壊されてしまっておる。
このままでは利用することはできぬじゃろう。
text.official_en:
This facility has been destroyed, alas. There's no use
for it in its current state.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ふーむ……いつまでもこのまま
というのも少々不便かもしれん。
text.official_en:
'Twould be a shame for it to remain in these
shambles though.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
必要な物資を提供してやることで
この施設を復興させることが可能じゃ。
text.official_en:
If we can provide the right resources, perhaps we
could restore it to its former glory.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おぬし、彼処を見るが良い。
冥界の瘴気が漏れ出しておるのがわかるか？
text.official_en:
Look there. Do you see the underworld miasma
pouring forth?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
顕世と冥界の境界がほつれ、異なる世界が
繋がりかけておるのじゃ。あれを放置すれば――
text.official_en:
The line between this world and the underworld is
beginning to blur. We must act swiftly...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
冥界の軍勢が此方に踏み込んでこよう。
まずはあれをなんとかするのじゃ。
text.official_en:
else the armies of the underworld will overrun this
area. We must put a stop to that first.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どうやらこの瘴気は結界と結びついておる。
疾く部隊を向かわせて瘴気を払うのじゃ。
text.official_en:
I believe this miasma is tied to the barrier. We ought
to send squads to dispel it at once.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
すべての瘴気を払うことが出来れば、
瘴気結界も消滅するはずじゃ。
text.official_en:
Once we've dispelled all the miasma, the barrier
tied to it should disappear.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どうやら瘴気結界を
消滅させられたようじゃな。
text.official_en: Well done in dispelling the miasma barrier.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ならば、もはや立ち止まる理由は無い。
冥界の門の破壊に向かうのじゃ！
text.official_en:
We've stood idle long enough. Let's be on our way
to destroy the underworld gate!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
冥界軍がダグシオンを狙っておるようじゃな。
攻め込まれぬよう、守りを固めるのじゃ。
text.official_en:
The risen dead have turned their attention to
Dagsion. Are our defenses enough to keep them out?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こここそがこの地に残った最後の希望の地……
決して忘れるでないぞ、おぬし！
text.official_en:
Always remember that this place is the last bastion
of hope in our ruined land.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フォトナ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
複数の門が同時に実体化したか。
よいか、一つとして討ち漏らすでないぞ！
text.official_en:
Multiple gates are manifesting at once. You must not
fail to deal with them all!
